headline: Demolition update for 210 Bog Road and Demolition Delay Ordinance amendments, plus Master Plan items.
summary: This is the October 1 agenda, and no November 5 agenda was provided. Listed business includes the 210 Bog Road demolition, Master Plan historic resources, and Demolition Delay Ordinance amendments.
items: Review Section VIII Historic Resources of the Master Plan 2030
Heritage Sign Program Review Committee update
Planning Board update on the Master Plan, including a recap of the September 19 Community Vision Session open house
Nominations of Heritage Commission members to the Planning Board's Master Plan Advisory Subcommittee
City Council update on Demolition Delay Ordinance amendments
